rev.t: I had a lovely visit to Theobroma Bakery! 🍰 The food was quite satisfying, and the service was attentive. The atmosphere really stood out—it was very welcoming and pleasant. ✨ A good spot to relax and enjoy a treat. 😊 …

I had a very positive online ordering experience via Swiggy. The order was delivered in less than 15 minutes in a very cute & attentive packaging. The pineapple pastry was very sweet for me. The Dutch truffle pastry was absolutely spot on in consistency & flavour.

Absolutely love this place !!
Brownies are the best here, most of our celebratory cakes are from here.
Sevice is so good they help us in choosing the best cakes and pack it …
